title: Africa–Asia rhodium exports
note: Rhodium, unwrought or in powder form (HS 711031), and rhodium in other semi-manufactured forms (HS 711039). The two codes are stored separately and must not be added. Reporter exports to the other region only. Values under USD 1 million are omitted. A missing pair is not zero trade. A missing code or year is not zero and must not be filled from the other rhodium code, from another year, or from another reporter. Customs weight is kilograms, not troy ounces, and is not a platinum or palladium price. Net weight and quantity can both be kilograms and still differ; they must not be substituted. A null net weight is not zero. Quantity 0 with unit code -1 is not a measured kilogram weight. This is not the HS 7110 heading. It is not platinum (HS 711011 or HS 711019), not palladium (HS 711021 or HS 711029), not iridium, osmium, and ruthenium (HS 711041 or HS 711049), not precious-metal ores (HS 2616), not waste and scrap (HS 7112), not jewelry (HS 7113), not gold (HS 7108), and not silver (HS 7106). Mine production is absent from this database, not zero. The Pink Sheet has no rhodium series, so no rhodium price is stored. The stored platinum benchmark is not a rhodium price and not the customs unit value. South Africa to Japan in 2024, 2023, and 2025 differ, so those years must not be substituted. Within each of those code-years the net weight and quantity use unit code 8 and match. South Africa unwrought rhodium to Hong Kong, Japan, and India was kept in 2023, 2024, and 2025. South Africa semi-manufactured rhodium to Japan was kept in each of those years. South Africa semi-manufactured rhodium to Hong Kong was kept in 2025. South Africa unwrought rhodium to China in 2023 was under USD 1 million and is not stored. South Africa returned no rhodium row to China in 2024. South Africa unwrought rhodium to China in 2025 was kept, and both weight fields match. South Africa returned no semi-manufactured rhodium row to China in 2025. South Africa unwrought rhodium to Korea in 2025 was kept. South Africa to India in 2023 has both weight fields at 3.8 kg. That row was stored as reported and was not corrected. It is not a rhodium benchmark. Zimbabwe 2023, 2024, and 2025 returned no rhodium rows against Asia. Those years must not be filled from South Africa. No Asia-to-Africa flow reached USD 1 million. The United Arab Emirates returned no rhodium rows against Africa in 2023, 2024, and 2025.
